verdict.rationale: GoDaddy's docs claim 'member-level rates with no membership fee, no API access fee' (godaddy-docs-3/26), which gestures at low-margin pricing, but there's no registry-fee breakdown or explicit at-cost/wholesale guarantee. Multiple independent community reports directly contradict any near-wholesale positioning, citing repeated price increases, constant upsells, and domains described as 'overpriced' (godaddy-comm-3, godaddy-comm-7, godaddy-comm-9, godaddy-comm-10). Missing for 10: a published cost breakdown showing registry fee vs. markup, an explicit at-cost/wholesale pricing guarantee, and independent verification that prices track wholesale rather than rising over time.
